newsitem.title: USA: Outdoor closes $1 bln buy of 3M unit.
newsitem.headline: Outdoor closes $1 bln buy of 3M unit.

text.p: Outdoor Systems Inc said Monday it had completed its $1 billion purchase of Minnesota Mining and Manufacturing Co's outdoor advertising operations, National Advertising Co.

With the acquisition, Outdoor Systems said it now operates about 220,000 poster, bulletin, transit shelter, subway and mall displays in 96 of the top 100 U.S. advertising markets, and seven of the top 10 Canadian markets.
The company also said that in conjunction with this deal, it sold certain markets that it acquired from 3M to Lamar Advertising Co for $116 million cash.

The 3M deal, net of the assets sold to Lamar, includes about 20,800 bulletins and 2,400 poster panels in 38 states, and 6,700 advertising displays in 690 regional malls throughout the U.S., Outdoor Syatems said.

Separately, Outdoor Systems said it had filed an application to list its common stock on the New York Stock Exchange. It said it expects to begin trading on the NYSE under the symbol OSI in the first week of September.
